meta.title: Flash Skin
meta.description: A portrait-driven skin whose backdrop swaps character portraits as the reasoning level rises and flips the shell from light to dark at the top tiers. Three drivers are available — manual, follow-reasoning and a composite weighted mode that scores token usage, context pressure, reasoning effort and token speed in real time and maps the score straight onto the groups actual frame count; per-signal weights and decay tuning are configurable in the detail page.
